=== src/maintenance/ticket-fields.mjs
     1	export const PRIORITIES = Object.freeze(['urgent', 'high', 'normal', 'low']);
     2	
     3	const trimmed = (value) => (typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '');
     4	
     5	export const requireText = (value, label) => {
     6	    const text = trimmed(value);
     7	    if (!text) throw new Error(`${label} is required`);
     8	    return text;
     9	};
    10	
    11	export const normalizePriority = (priority) => {
    12	    const value = trimmed(priority).toLowerCase();
    13	    if (!PRIORITIES.includes(value)) throw new Error('priority is unknown');
    14	    return value;
    15	};
    16	
    17	export const normalizeAmenities = (amenities) => {
    18	    if (!Array.isArray(amenities)) throw new Error('amenities must be a list');
    19	    const names = amenities.map((amenity) => requireText(amenity, 'amenity name').toLowerCase());
    20	    return [...new Set(names)];
    21	};
    22	
    23	export const prepareTicket = (request) => ({
    24	    roomId: requireText(request.roomId, 'room'),
    25	    buildingId: requireText(request.buildingId, 'building'),
    26	    summary: requireText(request.summary, 'summary'),
    27	    priority: normalizePriority(request.priority),
    28	    amenities: normalizeAmenities(request.amenities),
    29	});
=== src/maintenance/ticket-policy.mjs
     1	import {overlaps} from '../platform/periods.mjs';
     2	import {minutes} from '../platform/time.mjs';
     3	
     4	export const RESPONSE_MINUTES = Object.freeze({urgent: 60, high: 240, normal: 1440, low: 4320});
     5	
     6	export const MAX_WORK_MINUTES = 480;
     7	
     8	export const respondBy = (priority, openedAt) => openedAt + minutes(RESPONSE_MINUTES[priority]);
     9	
    10	const ESCALATION = Object.freeze({low: 'normal', normal: 'high', high: 'urgent'});
    11	
    12	export const escalatedPriority = (priority) => {
    13	    const next = ESCALATION[priority];
    14	    if (next === undefined) throw new Error(`cannot escalate a ${priority} ticket`);
    15	    return next;
    16	};
    17	
    18	export const isOverdue = (ticket, at) => ticket.state === 'open' && at >= ticket.respondBy;
    19	
    20	const PLANNABLE = Object.freeze(['open', 'assigned']);
    21	
    22	export const canPlan = (ticket) => PLANNABLE.includes(ticket.state);
    23	
    24	export const checkWorkWindow = (window, at) => {
    25	    if (!(window.endAt > window.startAt)) throw new Error('work window is invalid');
    26	    if (window.startAt < at) throw new Error('work window has started');
    27	    if (window.endAt - window.startAt > minutes(MAX_WORK_MINUTES)) throw new Error('work window is too long');
    28	    return {startAt: window.startAt, endAt: window.endAt};
    29	};
    30	
    31	export const conflictingTicket = (tickets, ticket, window) => tickets.find((other) => (
    32	    other.roomId === ticket.roomId
    33	    && hasOpenPlan(other)
    34	    && overlaps(other.plannedWork, window)
    35	)) ?? null;
    36	
    37	const byId = (left, right) => (left.id < right.id ? -1 : left.id > right.id ? 1 : 0);
    38	
    39	export const orderByDeadline = (tickets) => [...tickets].sort((left, right) => (
    40	    left.respondBy - right.respondBy || byId(left, right)
    41	));
    42	
    43	export const orderByWorkStart = (tickets) => [...tickets].sort((left, right) => (
    44	    left.plannedWork.startAt - right.plannedWork.startAt || byId(left, right)
    45	));
    46	
    47	export const hasOpenPlan = (ticket) => ticket.state !== 'resolved' && ticket.plannedWork !== undefined;

     5	} from './ticket-policy.mjs';

     8	const openedNotice = (ticket) => Object.freeze({
     9	    ticketId: ticket.id,
    10	    roomId: ticket.roomId,
    11	    buildingId: ticket.buildingId,
    12	    priority: ticket.priority,
    13	    respondBy: ticket.respondBy,
    14	});
    15	
    16	const assignmentNotice = (ticket) => Object.freeze({
    17	    ticketId: ticket.id,
    18	    assignee: ticket.assignee,
    19	    roomId: ticket.roomId,
    20	    respondBy: ticket.respondBy,
    21	});
    22	
    23	const escalationNotice = (ticket) => Object.freeze({ticketId: ticket.id, priority: ticket.priority, respondBy: ticket.respondBy});
    24	
    25	const resolutionNotice = (ticket) => Object.freeze({ticketId: ticket.id, roomId: ticket.roomId, resolvedAt: ticket.resolvedAt});
    26	
    27	const saveThenSend = async (store, send, ticket) => {
    28	    const saved = await store.save(ticket);
    29	    await send(saved);
    30	    return saved;
    31	};
    32	
    33	export const openTicket = async ({nextId, notifier, now, request, store}) => {
    34	    const prepared = prepareTicket(request);
    35	    const at = now();
    36	    const ticket = newTicket({at, id: nextId(), prepared, respondBy: respondBy(prepared.priority, at)});
    37	    return saveThenSend(store, (saved) => notifier.opened(openedNotice(saved)), ticket);
    38	};
    39	
    40	export const findTicket = async ({id, store}) => {
    41	    const ticket = await store.find(id);
    42	    if (ticket === null) throw new Error('ticket not found');
    43	    return ticket;
    44	};
    45	
    46	export const assignTicket = async ({assignee, notifier, now, store, ticket}) => {
    47	    const name = requireText(assignee, 'assignee');
    48	    const assigned = {...advanceTicket(ticket, 'assign', now()), assignee: name};
    49	    return saveThenSend(store, (saved) => notifier.assigned(assignmentNotice(saved)), assigned);
    50	};
    51	
    52	export const startWork = async ({now, store, ticket}) => {
    53	    const started = advanceTicket(ticket, 'start', now());
    54	    await store.save(started);
    55	    return started;
    56	};
    57	
    58	export const resolveTicket = async ({notifier, now, resolution, store, ticket}) => {
    59	    const note = requireText(resolution, 'resolution');
    60	    const resolved = {...advanceTicket(ticket, 'resolve', now()), resolution: note};
    61	    return saveThenSend(store, (saved) => notifier.resolved(resolutionNotice(saved)), resolved);
    62	};
    63	
    64	export const planWork = async ({endAt, now, startAt, store, ticket}) => {
    65	    if (!canPlan(ticket)) throw new Error(`cannot plan work for a ${ticket.state} ticket`);
    66	    if (ticket.plannedWork !== undefined) throw new Error('ticket already has planned work');
    67	    const at = now();
    68	    const window = checkWorkWindow({startAt, endAt}, at);
    69	    const sameRoom = await store.list({roomId: ticket.roomId});
    70	    if (conflictingTicket(sameRoom, ticket, window) !== null) throw new Error('work window conflicts with another ticket');
    71	    const planned = {...ticket, ...replan(ticket, window), plannedAt: at};
    72	    await store.save(planned);
    73	    return planned;
    74	};
    75	
    76	export const overdueTickets = async ({buildingId, now, store}) => {
    77	    const at = now();
    78	    const tickets = await store.list({buildingId: requireText(buildingId, 'building')});
    79	    return orderByDeadline(tickets.filter((ticket) => isOverdue(ticket, at)));
    80	};
    81	
    82	export const clearPlannedWork = async ({now, store, ticket}) => {
    83	    if (!canPlan(ticket)) throw new Error(`cannot plan work for a ${ticket.state} ticket`);
    84	    if (ticket.plannedWork === undefined) return ticket;
    85	    const cleared = {...ticket, ...replan(ticket, null), plannedAt: now()};
    86	    await store.save(cleared);
    87	    return cleared;
    88	};
    89	
    90	export const escalateTicket = async ({notifier, now, store, ticket}) => {
    91	    if (ticket.state === 'resolved') throw new Error('cannot escalate a resolved ticket');
    92	    const priority = escalatedPriority(ticket.priority);
    93	    const escalated = {
    94	        ...ticket,
    95	        priority,
    96	        respondBy: respondBy(priority, ticket.openedAt),
    97	        lastEscalation: {from: ticket.priority, to: priority, at: now()},
    98	    };
    99	    return saveThenSend(store, (saved) => notifier.escalated(escalationNotice(saved)), escalated);
   100	};
   101	
   102	export const plannedWorkFor = async ({roomId, store}) => orderByWorkStart(
   103	    (await store.list({roomId: requireText(roomId, 'room')})).filter(hasOpenPlan),
   104	);
   105	
   106	export const unavailableAmenities = async ({roomId, store}) => {
   107	    const tickets = await store.list({roomId: requireText(roomId, 'room')});
   108	    const names = tickets.filter((ticket) => ticket.state !== 'resolved').flatMap((ticket) => ticket.amenities);
   109	    return [...new Set(names)].sort();
   110	};
=== src/maintenance/ticket-states.mjs
     1	import {withOptional} from '../platform/records.mjs';
     2	
     3	const RULES = Object.freeze([
     4	    {action: 'assign', from: ['open', 'assigned'], to: 'assigned', stamp: 'assignedAt'},
     5	    {action: 'start', from: ['assigned'], to: 'inProgress', stamp: 'startedAt'},
     6	    {action: 'resolve', from: ['inProgress'], to: 'resolved', stamp: 'resolvedAt'},
     7	]);
     8	
     9	export const newTicket = ({at, id, prepared, respondBy}) => ({
    10	    id,
    11	    ...prepared,
    12	    state: 'open',
    13	    openedAt: at,
    14	    respondBy,
    15	    lastEscalation: null,
    16	});
    17	
    18	export const replan = (ticket, window) => withOptional(ticket, 'plannedWork', window);
    19	
    20	export const advanceTicket = (ticket, action, at) => {
    21	    const rule = RULES.find((candidate) => candidate.action === action && candidate.from.includes(ticket.state));
    22	    if (rule === undefined) throw new Error(`cannot ${action} a ${ticket.state} ticket`);
    23	    return {...ticket, state: rule.to, [rule.stamp]: at};
    24	};
=== src/maintenance/ticket-store.mjs
     1	export const createTicketStore = (initialTickets = []) => {
     2	    const records = new Map(initialTickets.map((ticket) => [ticket.id, ticket]));
     3	    let writes = Promise.resolve();
     4	
     5	    return Object.freeze({
     6	        find: async (id) => records.get(id) ?? null,
     7	        list: async ({buildingId, roomId} = {}) => [...records.values()].filter((ticket) => (
     8	            (buildingId === undefined || ticket.buildingId === buildingId) && (roomId === undefined || ticket.roomId === roomId)
     9	        )),
    10	        save: (ticket) => {
    11	            writes = writes.then(() => {
    12	                records.set(ticket.id, ticket);
    13	                return ticket;
    14	            });
    15	            return writes;
    16	        },
    17	    });
    18	};
=== src/members/allowance.mjs
     1	import {instant, overlaps} from '../platform/periods.mjs';
     2	import {MINUTE} from '../platform/time.mjs';
     3	import {suspensionPeriod} from './periods.mjs';
     4	
     5	export const MONTHLY_ALLOWANCE_MINUTES = Object.freeze({basic: 600, plus: 1800, team: 6000});
     6	
     7	const bookedMinutes = (reservation) => (reservation.endAt - reservation.startAt) / MINUTE;
     8	
     9	export const countedReservations = (reservations, memberId, period) => reservations.filter((reservation) => (
    10	    reservation.memberId === memberId
    11	    && reservation.state === 'confirmed'
    12	    && overlaps(instant(reservation.startAt), period)
    13	));
    14	
    15	const suspendedDuring = (member, period) => member.suspension !== undefined && overlaps(suspensionPeriod(member.suspension), period);
    16	
    17	const byStart = (left, right) => left.startAt - right.startAt || (left.id < right.id ? -1 : left.id > right.id ? 1 : 0);
    18	
    19	export const allowanceSummary = (member, reservations, period) => {
    20	    const allowance = MONTHLY_ALLOWANCE_MINUTES[member.tier];
    21	    const counted = countedReservations(reservations, member.memberId, period).sort(byStart);
    22	    const used = counted.reduce((total, reservation) => total + bookedMinutes(reservation), 0);
    23	    return Object.freeze({
    24	        memberId: member.memberId,
    25	        tier: member.tier,
    26	        periodStart: period.startAt,
    27	        periodEnd: period.endAt,
    28	        allowance,
    29	        used,
    30	        remaining: Math.max(allowance - used, 0),
    31	        overage: Math.max(used - allowance, 0),
    32	        reservationIds: counted.map((reservation) => reservation.id),
    33	        suspended: suspendedDuring(member, period),
    34	    });
    35	};

     1	import {allowanceSummary} from './allowance.mjs';

     7	const requireMember = async (store, memberId) => {
     8	    const member = await store.find(normalizeMemberId(memberId));
     9	    if (member === null) throw new Error('member not found');
    10	    return member;
    11	};
    12	
    13	export const registerMember = async ({notifier, now, profile, store}) => {
    14	    const prepared = prepareProfile(profile);
    15	    if (await store.find(prepared.memberId) !== null) throw new Error('member already exists');
    16	    if (await store.findByEmail(prepared.email) !== null) throw new Error('email is already registered');
    17	    const at = now();
    18	    const member = {...prepared, status: 'active', joinedAt: at};
    19	    return saveAndNotify(store, (saved) => notifier.registered(welcomeNotice(saved)), member);
    20	};
    21	
    22	export const getMember = ({memberId, store}) => requireMember(store, memberId);
    23	
    24	export const memberStatus = async ({memberId, now, store}) => effectiveStatus(await requireMember(store, memberId), now());
    25	
    26	export const monthlyAllowance = async ({memberId, month, reservations, store}) => {
    27	    const member = await requireMember(store, memberId);
    28	    return allowanceSummary(member, reservations, usageMonth(month));
    29	};
    30	
    31	export const updateContact = async ({contact, memberId, store}) => {
    32	    const member = await requireMember(store, memberId);
    33	    const prepared = prepareContact(contact);
    34	    const owner = await store.findByEmail(prepared.email);
    35	    if (owner !== null && prepared.email !== member.email) throw new Error('email is already registered');
    36	    const updated = {...member, ...prepared};
    37	    await store.save(updated);
    38	    return updated;
    39	};
    40	
    41	export const changeTier = async ({memberId, store, tier}) => {
    42	    const member = await requireMember(store, memberId);
    43	    const updated = {...member, tier: requireTier(tier)};
    44	    await store.save(updated);
    45	    return updated;
    46	};
    47	
    48	export const suspendMember = async ({durationMinutes, memberId, notifier, now, reason, store}) => {
    49	    const member = await requireMember(store, memberId);
    50	    const suspended = suspend(member, {durationMinutes, reason: prepareReason(reason)}, now());
    51	    return saveAndNotify(store, (saved) => notifier.suspended(suspensionNotice(saved)), suspended);
    52	};
    53	
    54	export const reinstateMember = async ({memberId, now, store}) => {
    55	    const member = await requireMember(store, memberId);
    56	    const reinstated = reinstate(member, now());
    57	    await store.save(reinstated);
    58	    return reinstated;
    59	};
    60	
    61	const byMemberId = (left, right) => (left.memberId < right.memberId ? -1 : left.memberId > right.memberId ? 1 : 0);
    62	
    63	const directoryEntry = (member, at) => Object.freeze({
    64	    memberId: member.memberId,
    65	    name: member.name,
    66	    email: member.email,
    67	    tier: member.tier,
    68	    status: effectiveStatus(member, at),
    69	});
    70	
    71	export const listMembers = async ({now, status, store}) => {
    72	    const at = now();
    73	    return (await store.list())
    74	        .map((member) => directoryEntry(member, at))
    75	        .filter((entry) => status === undefined || entry.status === status)
    76	        .sort(byMemberId);

=== src/members/member-store.mjs
     1	export const createMemberStore = (initialMembers = []) => {
     2	    const records = new Map(initialMembers.map((member) => [member.memberId, member]));
     3	    let writes = Promise.resolve();
     4	
     5	    return Object.freeze({
     6	        find: async (memberId) => records.get(memberId) ?? null,
     7	        findByEmail: async (email) => [...records.values()].find((member) => member.email === email) ?? null,
     8	        list: async () => [...records.values()],
     9	        save: (member) => {
    10	            writes = writes.then(() => {
    11	                records.set(member.memberId, member);
    12	                return member;
    13	            });
    14	            return writes;
    15	        },
    16	    });

=== src/members/periods.mjs
     1	const FIRST_YEAR = 1970;
     2	const LAST_YEAR = 9999;
     3	
     4	export const usageMonth = ({month, year}) => {
     5	    if (!Number.isInteger(year) || year < FIRST_YEAR || year > LAST_YEAR) throw new Error('usage year is invalid');
     6	    if (!Number.isInteger(month) || month < 1 || month > 12) throw new Error('usage month is invalid');
     7	    return {startAt: Date.UTC(year, month - 1, 1), endAt: Date.UTC(year, month, 1)};
     8	};
     9	
    10	export const suspensionPeriod = (suspension) => ({startAt: suspension.startedAt, endAt: suspension.expiresAt});
=== src/members/profile.mjs
     1	export const TIERS = Object.freeze(['basic', 'plus', 'team']);
     2	
     3	const trimmed = (value) => (typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '');
     4	
     5	export const normalizeMemberId = (memberId) => trimmed(memberId);
     6	
     7	export const normalizeEmail = (email) => trimmed(email).toLowerCase();
     8	
     9	export const requireTier = (tier) => {
    10	    if (!TIERS.includes(tier)) throw new Error('membership tier is unknown');
    11	    return tier;

    13	
    14	export const prepareContact = (contact) => {
    15	    const name = trimmed(contact.name);
    16	    const email = normalizeEmail(contact.email);
    17	    if (!name) throw new Error('member name is required');
    18	    if (!email) throw new Error('member email is required');
    19	    return {name, email};
    20	};
    21	
    22	export const prepareProfile = (profile) => {
    23	    const memberId = normalizeMemberId(profile.memberId);
    24	    if (!memberId) throw new Error('member id is required');
    25	    return {memberId, ...prepareContact(profile), tier: requireTier(profile.tier)};
    26	};

=== src/members/suspension.mjs
     1	import {withOptional} from '../platform/records.mjs';
     2	import {minutes} from '../platform/time.mjs';
     3	
     4	export const MAX_SUSPENSION_MINUTES = 43_200;
     5	
     6	export const isSuspended = (member, at) => member.suspension !== undefined && at < member.suspension.expiresAt;
     7	
     8	export const effectiveStatus = (member, at) => (isSuspended(member, at) ? 'suspended' : 'active');
     9	
    10	const isValidLength = (length) => Number.isInteger(length) && length >= 1 && length <= MAX_SUSPENSION_MINUTES;
    11	
    12	export const suspend = (member, {durationMinutes, reason}, at) => {
    13	    if (isSuspended(member, at)) throw new Error('member is already suspended');
    14	    if (!isValidLength(durationMinutes)) throw new Error('suspension length is invalid');
    15	    return {
    16	        ...member,
    17	        status: 'suspended',
    18	        suspension: {reason, startedAt: at, expiresAt: at + minutes(durationMinutes)},
    19	    };
    20	};
    21	
    22	export const reinstate = (member, at) => {
    23	    if (!isSuspended(member, at)) throw new Error('member is not suspended');
    24	    return withOptional({...member, status: 'active'}, 'suspension', null);
    25	};
=== src/messaging/digest.mjs
     1	export const DIGEST_LIMIT = 20;
     2	
     3	export const QUEUE_LIMIT = 50;
     4	
     5	const byId = (left, right) => (left.id < right.id ? -1 : left.id > right.id ? 1 : 0);
     6	
     7	const byQueueOrder = (left, right) => left.queuedAt - right.queuedAt || byId(left, right);
     8	
     9	export const isReleased = (message, at) => message.state === 'queued' && message.releaseAt <= at;
    10	
    11	export const queuedFor = (messages, memberId) => messages.filter((message) => (
    12	    message.memberId === memberId && message.state === 'queued'
    13	));
    14	
    15	export const groupDigests = (messages, at) => {
    16	    const byMember = new Map();
    17	    for (const message of messages.filter((candidate) => isReleased(candidate, at))) {
    18	        byMember.set(message.memberId, [...(byMember.get(message.memberId) ?? []), message]);
    19	    }
    20	    return [...byMember.keys()].sort().map((memberId) => ({
    21	        memberId,
    22	        messages: byMember.get(memberId).sort(byQueueOrder).slice(0, DIGEST_LIMIT),
    23	    }));
    24	};
    25	
    26	export const markSent = (message, at) => ({
    27	    ...message,
    28	    state: 'sent',
    29	    sentAt: at,
    30	});
    31	
    32	export const digestNotice = (memberId, messages) => Object.freeze({
    33	    memberId,
    34	    messageIds: messages.map((message) => message.id),
    35	    bodies: messages.map((message) => message.body),
    36	});
    37	
    38	export const withdraw = (message, at) => {
    39	    if (message.state === 'canceled') return message;
    40	    if (message.state !== 'queued') throw new Error(`cannot withdraw a ${message.state} message`);
    41	    return {
    42	        ...message,
    43	        state: 'canceled',
    44	        canceledAt: at,
    45	    };
    46	};
=== src/messaging/locale-catalog.mjs
     1	export const FALLBACK_LOCALE = 'en';
     2	
     3	export const normalizeLocale = (locale) => {
     4	    const normalized = typeof locale === 'string' ? locale.trim().toLowerCase() : '';
     5	    return normalized === '' ? FALLBACK_LOCALE : normalized;
     6	};
     7	
     8	export const loadCatalog = (rawCatalog) => new Map(
     9	    Object.entries(rawCatalog).map(([locale, templates]) => [locale.trim().toLowerCase(), templates]),
    10	);
    11	
    12	export const localeCandidates = (locale) => [...new Set([locale, locale.split('-')[0], FALLBACK_LOCALE])];
    13	
    14	export const resolveTemplate = (catalog, templateName, locale) => {
    15	    for (const candidate of localeCandidates(locale)) {
    16	        const template = catalog.get(candidate)?.[templateName];
    17	        if (typeof template === 'string') return {locale: candidate, template};
    18	    }
    19	    throw new Error('template is unavailable');
    20	};
=== src/messaging/messaging-service.mjs
     1	import {QUEUE_LIMIT, digestNotice, groupDigests, markSent, queuedFor, withdraw} from './digest.mjs';
     2	import {loadCatalog, normalizeLocale, resolveTemplate} from './locale-catalog.mjs';
     3	import {isQuiet, prepareQuietHours, releaseTime} from './quiet-hours.mjs';
     4	import {renderTemplate} from './template-render.mjs';
     5	
     6	const requiredText = (value, label) => {
     7	    const text = typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '';
     8	    if (!text) throw new Error(`${label} is required`);
     9	    return text;
    10	};
    11	
    12	const normalizeMessageKey = (key) => (typeof key === 'string' && key.trim() !== '' ? key.trim().toLowerCase() : null);
    13	
    14	const draftMessage = ({member, request}) => {
    15	    const memberId = requiredText(member.id, 'member');
    16	    const templateName = requiredText(request.templateName, 'template');
    17	    return {memberId, templateName, messageKey: normalizeMessageKey(request.messageKey)};
    18	};
    19	
    20	const sentNotice = (message) => Object.freeze({messageId: message.id, memberId: message.memberId, body: message.body});
    21	
    22	export const sendMessage = async ({catalog, member, nextId, now, request, send, store}) => {
    23	    const draft = draftMessage({member, request});
    24	    if (draft.messageKey !== null) {
    25	        const existing = await store.findByMessageKey(draft.messageKey);
    26	        if (existing !== null) return existing;
    27	    }
    28	    const hours = prepareQuietHours(member);
    29	    const resolved = resolveTemplate(loadCatalog(catalog), draft.templateName, normalizeLocale(member.locale));
    30	    const body = renderTemplate(resolved.template, request.values ?? {});
    31	    const at = now();
    32	    const quiet = isQuiet(hours, at);
    33	    if (quiet && queuedFor(await store.list({state: 'queued'}), draft.memberId).length >= QUEUE_LIMIT) {
    34	        throw new Error('member has too many queued messages');
    35	    }
    36	    const base = {
    37	        id: nextId(),
    38	        memberId: draft.memberId,
    39	        messageKey: draft.messageKey,
    40	        templateName: draft.templateName,
    41	        locale: resolved.locale,
    42	        body,
    43	    };
    44	    if (quiet) {
    45	        const queued = {
    46	            ...base,
    47	            state: 'queued',
    48	            queuedAt: at,
    49	            releaseAt: releaseTime(hours, at),
    50	        };
    51	        return store.save(queued);
    52	    }
    53	    const sent = {...base, state: 'sent', sentAt: at};
    54	    const saved = store.save(sent);
    55	    await send(sentNotice(sent));
    56	    return saved;
    57	};
    58	
    59	export const flushDigests = async ({now, sendDigest, store}) => {
    60	    const at = now();
    61	    const digests = groupDigests(await store.list({state: 'queued'}), at);
    62	    const notices = [];
    63	    for (const digest of digests) {
    64	        const sent = digest.messages.map((message) => markSent(message, at));
    65	        for (const message of sent) await store.save(message);
    66	        const notice = digestNotice(digest.memberId, sent);
    67	        await sendDigest(notice);
    68	        notices.push(notice);
    69	    }
    70	    return notices;
    71	};
    72	
    73	export const withdrawMessage = async ({messageId, now, store}) => {
    74	    const message = await store.findById(messageId);
    75	    if (message === null) throw new Error('message is unknown');
    76	    const next = withdraw(message, now());
    77	    if (next === message) return message;
    78	    return store.save(next);
    79	};
=== src/messaging/outbox-store.mjs
     1	export const createOutboxStore = (initialMessages = []) => {
     2	    const messages = new Map(initialMessages.map((message) => [message.id, message]));
     3	    let writes = Promise.resolve();
     4	
     5	    return Object.freeze({
     6	        findById: async (messageId) => messages.get(messageId) ?? null,
     7	        findByMessageKey: async (messageKey) => (
     8	            [...messages.values()].find((message) => message.messageKey === messageKey) ?? null
     9	        ),
    10	        list: async ({state} = {}) => [...messages.values()].filter((message) => (
    11	            state === undefined || message.state === state
    12	        )),
    13	        save: (message) => {
    14	            writes = writes.then(() => {
    15	                messages.set(message.id, message);
    16	                return message;
    17	            });
    18	            return writes;
    19	        },
    20	    });
    21	};
=== src/messaging/quiet-hours.mjs
     1	import {MINUTE, minutes} from '../platform/time.mjs';
     2	
     3	const DAY_MINUTES = 1440;
     4	
     5	const isMinuteOfDay = (value) => Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0 && value < DAY_MINUTES;
     6	
     7	export const prepareQuietHours = (member) => {
     8	    const offset = member.utcOffsetMinutes ?? 0;
     9	    if (!Number.isInteger(offset) || offset < -720 || offset > 840) throw new Error('member offset is invalid');
    10	    if (member.quietHours === undefined || member.quietHours === null) return {offset, quiet: null};
    11	    const {startMinute, endMinute} = member.quietHours;
    12	    if (!isMinuteOfDay(startMinute) || !isMinuteOfDay(endMinute)) throw new Error('quiet hours are invalid');
    13	    return {offset, quiet: {startMinute, endMinute}};
    14	};
    15	
    16	const minuteStart = (at) => at - (((at % MINUTE) + MINUTE) % MINUTE);
    17	
    18	export const localMinuteOfDay = (at, offset) => {
    19	    const total = (minuteStart(at) / MINUTE) + offset;
    20	    return ((total % DAY_MINUTES) + DAY_MINUTES) % DAY_MINUTES;
    21	};
    22	
    23	export const isQuiet = (hours, at) => {
    24	    if (hours.quiet === null) return false;
    25	    const {startMinute, endMinute} = hours.quiet;
    26	    const minute = localMinuteOfDay(at, hours.offset);
    27	    if (startMinute < endMinute) return startMinute <= minute && minute < endMinute;
    28	    if (startMinute > endMinute) return minute >= startMinute || minute < endMinute;
    29	    return false;
    30	};
    31	
    32	export const releaseTime = (hours, at) => {
    33	    const minute = localMinuteOfDay(at, hours.offset);
    34	    const wait = (hours.quiet.endMinute - minute + DAY_MINUTES) % DAY_MINUTES;
    35	    return minuteStart(at + MINUTE - 1) + minutes(wait);
    36	};
=== src/messaging/template-render.mjs
     1	const PLACEHOLDER = /\{\{([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\}\}/g;
     2	
     3	const ESCAPES = Object.freeze({
     4	    '&': '&amp;',
     5	    '<': '&lt;',
     6	    '>': '&gt;',
     7	    '"': '&quot;',
     8	    "'": '&#39;',
     9	});
    10	
    11	export const escapeText = (text) => text.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (character) => ESCAPES[character]);
    12	
    13	export const renderTemplate = (template, values) => template.replace(PLACEHOLDER, (match, name) => {
    14	    const value = Object.hasOwn(values, name) ? values[name] : undefined;
    15	    if (value === undefined || value === null) throw new Error(`template value ${name} is missing`);
    16	    return escapeText(String(value));
    17	});
